title: S0814 (2025 Regular): Weapons or Firearms at School-sponsored Events or on School Property

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2025-02-18; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/814/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 3128339))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2025-02-18); no passage vote recorded. Struck: 'possess'; no period follows 'do so' in the print (a struck colon is there) replaced by 'store'; the school-property exceptions (firearms programs, career-center ranges, vehicle carry under s. 790.25(4)) and the old definition of 'school' (including postsecondary) were struck; the old license-holder exception for stun guns at colleges was struck. operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.115, F.S.): A person may not store any firearm, electric weapon or device, destructive device, or other weapon as defined in s. 790.001, including a razor blade or box cutter, except as authorized in support of school-sanctioned activities, at a school-sponsored event or on the property of any school, school bus, or school bus stop; however, a person may carry a firearm on the property of any college or university, including, but not limited to, any dormitory or residence hall owned or operated by a college or university, and in any other location he or she is legally authorized to do so
Section 1 (s. 790.115, F.S.): As used in this section, the term “school” means a public preschool or any elementary school, middle school, junior high school, secondary school, or career center, regardless of whether public or private.
Section 1 (s. 790.115, F.S.): The Department of Law Enforcement may authorize a college or university, while hosting or sponsoring a sporting or athletic event, to designate a campus facility or area as a sensitive location in which the possession of a concealed weapon or a concealed firearm is prohibited. To receive such authorization, the college or university must submit a security plan to the Department of Law Enforcement for approval.
Section 2 (s. 790.06, F.S.): Any college or university facility or area the Department of Law Enforcement has authorized the college or university to designate as a sensitive location while the college or university hosts or sponsors a sporting or athletic event
